data.value: This model has no legend view yet

data.name: NoLegend_Message
data.value:
Revit's API can't create a legend view from scratch, so Gantt-It makes each chart by duplicating an existing legend. Your chart has not been generated, and nothing is downloaded or copied from another model.
Revit is paused while Gantt-It is open, so:

data.name: NoLegend_Step1
data.value: Close Gantt-It with × or Esc. Your chart is kept. (Cancel discards it.)

data.name: NoLegend_Step2
data.value: In Revit, choose View › Legends › Legend. Any name and scale will do.

data.name: NoLegend_Step3
data.value: Open Gantt-It again and press Generate.

data.name: Color_PickTip
data.value: Pick from screen: click any pixel on any monitor (Esc cancels). Picks the color as displayed.

data.name: Color_HexError
